title: Avocado Crema (Creamy, Dairy-Free & Ready in 5 Minutes)
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldName: Avocado Crema (Creamy, Dairy-Free & Ready in 5 Minutes)
ldIngredientsRaw: ¼ cup vegan yogurt ((such as soy, almond, or coconut))
ldInstructionsRaw: Blend: Add the avocado, yogurt, lime juice, garlic, and salt to a high-speed blender or small food processor and blend until completely smooth.
Thin: Add water 1 tablespoon at a time until you reach your desired drizzleable consistency.
Taste and finish: Taste and adjust salt and lime as needed.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ ¼ cup vegan yogurt, (such as soy, almond, or coconut)
▢ ¼ teaspoon salt, or to taste
▢ 2 - 4 tablespoons water, to thin as needed
